submission_format.builder_default: Current shared writer / TDX1: NaN nodata outside, finite [0,1] inside; no range-error-immunity claim
submission_format.zero_outside: Historical all-finite convention. The official reference notebook writes without an explicit nodata argument; owner-reported scores are not organizer confirmation. A whole-array range check does not prove portal acceptance or scientific readiness.
submission_format.historical_range_error_cause: Unknown exact upload. Feature sentinels and feature-derived footprint masks are documented possible failure modes, not a proven diagnosis of the historical rejection.

known_faults_masked_from_scoring.quote: Pixels corresponding to known USGS/INGENIOUS faults are masked / excluded from evaluation, so they do not count towards penalty terms. Re-evaluation will also mask/exclude the existing USGS/INGENIOUS faults.
known_faults_masked_from_scoring.consequence: Probability mass on catalogue pixels earns no TP and no FP, so it is pure waste of the emission budget. Every candidate must report dots_on_catalogue. See IR-30-047.
